scope: Theorem 8.4 (Critical moment bootstrap) of the manuscript “Rigidity of Smooth Billiards with a Continuous Caustic Collar” (preprints/Rigidity-of-Smooth-Billiards-with-a-Continuous-Caustic-Collar-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 147 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0fefc18481d52acb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 86. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let N be an envelope as in Theorem 8.1, assume the first-moment bound (8.8), and suppose supk≥k0 µ(k)/N(k) < ∞. Then µ(k) ≤ CN(k), E dk|P| N(k)2 ≤ C. (8.19) There is η > 0, depending only on the fixed envelope constants, such that dkM N(k) 2+η ≤ C. (8.20) The estimates for M hold also with suprema on every fixed tile. If N is nondecreasing, then in addition sup x dkM ≤ C(1 + k)N(k), sup x dk|P| N(k)2 ≤ C(1 + k)2 . (8.21)
